svg.title: Alkemio group structure with the two guardians
svg.desc: Alkemio Holding BV has five share classes. Purpose Control is held by the Guardian Foundation, Stichting Golden Share, behind which stands a council of entrepreneurs from the other companies it guards, which also approves some decisions. Steward Control and Steward Economic are held by Stichting Alkemio, whose board are the stewards. Contributor Capital and Contributor Time are capped economic rights, certified through STAK Participants Alkemio. Alkemio Holding BV owns the operating companies.
